en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a cobblestone street lined with two- and three‑story buildings, shutters on the windows, horse‑drawn carriages and a few people. In the background, on a hill above the town, stands a large castle-like complex with a prominent tower. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as a street view (Badgasse) in Colditz, and the publisher information appears below.
